meta.note: docket.css is the implementation; internal/web/tokens_test.go fails when the two disagree.

tokens.name: film
tokens.usage: The table the sheets lie on: the page background, under a faint 16 px grid.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet: the framed page every screen is drawn on. Also the ground of the reviewer's panel.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: code blocks, inputs, the tab strip, hover on a row.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Linework and headings: sheet frames, rules, titles, the primary button. What is in the pull request.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on sheet, film or sunk.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, details under a title.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Meta text and labels: timestamps, column heads, hints.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and cells. 1.8:1 on sheet: never text. Quiet and disabled buttons use it as their only border, which is below the 3:1 WCAG asks of a control's boundary (known gap).

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The 16 px grid ruled on film. Never on a sheet.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: The agent's mark: dashed borders and text for evidence, proofs, the work log, the agent's labels.

tokens.name: pencil-wash
tokens.usage: Fill inside a pencil box (anything the agent says or did).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The reviewer's mark and only binding colour: decisions, the verdict, 'needs you'. Never decoration, never an error colour.

tokens.name: red-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of a chosen option and of a red banner.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text on a red fill (a contradicted stamp, a chosen option key, a filled triangle).

tokens.name: add
tokens.usage: Diff: an added line's fill; also a changed value in a before/after table and text selection.

tokens.name: add-ink
tokens.usage: Text on add.

tokens.name: del
tokens.usage: Diff: a removed line's fill (always with strike-through, never red).

tokens.name: del-ink
tokens.usage: Text on del.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill: the primary button, a solid stamp, the toast.

families.mono: "Commit Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The wordmark in the title block. Uppercase.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Retry webhook deliveries with exponential backoff
styles.usage: .title: a sheet's title, mixed case. 24px under 720px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: .label, table heads and stamps (stamps track 0.1em). Uppercase, text-3; .label.ink for a section label.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: A delivery that times out is sent again.
styles.usage: .statement: a decision's finding, stated as fact.

styles.name: tally
styles.usage: .tally .big: a count in the tally strip. red when it is the reviewer's.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Webhook deliveries that fail are now retried up to five times.
styles.usage: .lede: the paragraph under a title, text-2, max 46em.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ran deliver() against a stub that returns 503 four times, then 200.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: pre.code and diffs (1.65 line height in diffs).

styles.name: cell
styles.usage: A title block value; numbers anywhere (.num uses tabular figures).

spacing.note: Everything sits on the 8 px unit --u; components write multiples as calc(var(--u) * n).

tokens.name: u-half
tokens.usage: calc(var(--u) / 2): between a title and its meta line, tight rows of stamps (.gap-s, .mt-s).

tokens.name: u
tokens.usage: --u, the unit. Gaps inside a control group (.gap-u, .mt).

tokens.name: u-1.5
tokens.usage: Cell padding, gaps inside a block (.block, .gap-m).

tokens.name: u-2
tokens.usage: Gap between items in a row (.row), padding of a pencil box.

tokens.name: u-3
tokens.usage: Padding of the reviewer's panel; the page gutter; between masthead and sheet.

tokens.name: u-4
tokens.usage: Padding of a sheet body; gap between blocks on a sheet (.gap-l).

tokens.name: u-5
tokens.usage: Between sections of the full diff (.gap-xl).

radius.note: Corners are square. Nothing has a radius or a shadow.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner: sheets, buttons, inputs, stamps.

stroke.note: Three line weights, as on a drawing.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rows, cells, the pencil box's dashed border.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: --line, the object line: buttons, stamps, rules, frames of a diff or a before/after.

tokens.name: heavy
tokens.usage: --heavy, the border line: a sheet's frame, the reviewer's panel, the active tab, a hot diff line's margin.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Nothing casts a shadow; depth is film under sheet.
